name: hud_perk_pierce_and_air_slow
description: The command card and the selection say the same numbers (review of M6's race views: the card's Q W E tooltip, Game.kit_tip, counted Keen Sight's reach but not Bronze Hand's pierce, which the build description beside it showed; a selected Sky Toll showed its +80% to fliers but not its slow of them). In High Water, where perks are on, the Bellfounder's Q tooltip reads 'Pierce 2' as her build description does once Q is pressed; her Chime Post, an aura that strikes nothing, shows no pierce in either. A Sky Toll of hers, selected, shows its stun, its share against fliers, its slow of fliers and Bronze Hand's pierce, all in the info area's width.

steps.msg: Bronze Hand: her hits ignore 2 armour

steps.assert:
node('Tooltip').visible and node('TooltipBody').text == 'A bronze clapper that strikes hard at close range.
Damage 30 · Range 2.6 · Cooldown 1.4s · Pierce 2 · Ground only
› Great Clapper +85: a far heavier strike
› Ringing Clapper +85: each strike rings through a crowd (Swarm)'
steps.msg: the Clapper Tower's tooltip counts Bronze Hand's pierce
as her build description does once Q is pressed
the Chime Post's build description shows no pierce: an aura strikes nothing

steps.assert: node('Tooltip').visible and node('TooltipBody').text.begins_with('Its hum cracks') and not node('TooltipBody').text.contains('Pierce')
cells.has(['Stun', '0.6s']) and cells.has(['Fliers', '+80%']) and cells.has(['Air slow', '50%']) and cells.has(['Pierce', '2'])
steps.msg: its stun, its share against fliers, its slow of them and Bronze Hand's pierce
every number fits the info area
